response.description:
Azure App Service on Azure Stack Hub will be retired on September
30, 2029. Starting September 30, 2026, new installations will
no longer be supported, and no new product releases, features, or enhancements
will be made available. Existing supported deployments can continue to run and
upgrade to the latest available release until retirement. Customers should begin planning migration to Azure App
Service in Azure now to continue receiving support, security updates, platform improvements,
and new capabilities. On September 30th, 2029, App Service on
Azure Stack will reach retirement and Microsoft support will end. Recommended action  Assessand migrate applications as soon as possible. Azure
App Service in Azure provides a fully managed platform with global availability,
Windows and Linux hosting options, autoscale, deployment slots, advanced
networking and security, Azure services integration, and continuous innovation. For applications with complex Windows dependencies, evaluate
Managed Instance on Azure App Service. It can help accelerate migration for
applications requiring registry access, COM components, custom runtimes, or
other Windows-specific dependencies. For a successful transition, inventory applications and
dependencies, assess compatibility, select the appropriate Azure hosting
target, migrate code, configuration, and data, validate workloads, and complete
migration before September 30, 2029. Learn more:  Benefits Plan Migrate
response.title: Retirement: Azure App Service on Azure Stack Hub
